Ta có $f(x) = 0 \Leftrightarrow \left[ \begin{array}{l} x = 0 \\ x = 1 \end{array} \right.$. \\
		Khi đó $\displaystyle S_1 + S_2 = \int_0^1 (-x^4 + x) - (x^4 - x^3) \text{d}x = \frac{7}{20}$. \\
		$\displaystyle S_2 = \int_0^1 a(x - x^2) - (x^4 - x^3) \text{d}x = \frac{a}{6} + \frac{1}{20}$. \\
		Mà $S_1 = 2S_2 \Rightarrow S_1 + S_2 = 3S_2 \Rightarrow \displaystyle \frac{7}{20} = 3 \left( \frac{a}{6} + \frac{1}{20} \right) \Rightarrow a = \frac{2}{5}$. \\
		Vậy $1 - 30a = 1 - 30 \cdot \frac{2}{5} = -11$. \\
